title: TikTok: preliminary findings on harmful “rabbit hole” effect
content: The European Commission has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act for the so-called ‘rabbit hole effect' of its recommender system.
snippet: The European Commission has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act for the so-called ‘rabbit hole effect' of its recommender system.

title: EU to push for accelerated global climate action at COP31
content: At the UN climate change conference in Antalya, Türkiye, 9-20 November, the EU will work with international partners to accelerate global climate action and deliver on the goals of the Paris Agreement. “We are committed to making this COP deliver,” said Commission President Ursula von der Leyen.

title: Shaping Europe’s future through education and training
content: The education and skills package helps reverse the decline in basic skills and improve teaching and how digital tools and AI are used in education. It focuses on four priorities and features a number of concrete initiatives that reflect changing labour market needs.

title: European Innovation Council launches €1.8 billion in funding for 2027
content: The European Innovation Council has launched €1.8 billion in funding for 2027 to support Europe's most promising deep tech entrepreneurs and researchers. The funding will help turn breakthrough research into market-ready innovations and strengthen Europe's ability to scale strategic technologies.

title: New plan to boost sustainable tourism in Europe
content: Europe is the world's leading travel destination and tourism is one of its greatest strategic economic assets. The new EU sustainable tourism strategy will increase the sector's competitiveness, sustainability and resilience while allowing tourists to discover our beautiful countries. Find out more.

title: Commission and European Space Agency launch new website on climate change research
content: To deepen our understanding of Earth's changing environment, the European Commission and the European Space Agency launched the Earth System Science Initiative, a website showcasing European research efforts on biodiversity loss, ocean health, polar change and climate extremes.

title: EU future enlargement: Countries' progress on the EU path
content: Enlargement is a merit-based process where enlargement countries must align with EU values and legislation to become an EU Member State. The European Commission has assessed the progress made over the past year by countries looking to join the EU and set out reform priorities for the way forward.

title: Commission gives guidelines on how Europeans can prepare for a crisis
content: As Europe faces increasingly frequent crises, the European Commission has presented new guidelines to help people and communities prepare for emergencies. The guidelines include advice on what essentials to pack for a 72-hour emergency and making sure persons with disabilities are not excluded.

title: Protecting Europe with stronger climate-resilience
content: The new EU framework for climate resilience strengthens Europe's ability to anticipate, prepare for, and manage climate risks. It does so by taking a proactive and systemic risk management approach and includes a new climate resilience law and practical tools.

title: Vision 2040 for a thriving fisheries and aquaculture sector
content: The European Commission has set out its vision for fisheries and aquaculture towards 2040. This outlines the course for fishers, aquaculture producers and local communities over the next 15 years to ensure a strong, competitive and sustainable blue economy.

title: An EU strategy for a rapidly changing Arctic
content: The Arctic is changing fast. From climate change to geopolitical tensions, there are challenges reshaping its security and economic landscape. The Commission has put forward a strategy for the Arctic - a framework of cooperation that places people, security, climate and prosperity at its core.

title: Apply now to be a European Climate Pact Ambassador!
content: If you’re committed to informing and inspiring climate action in your community, now is your chance to become a European Climate Pact Ambassador. All you need to demonstrate is that you’re ready to motivate others to take climate action and be a changemaker. Apply by 31 October 2026.

title: Staying one step ahead of breast cancer, our talk with Europa Donna
content: Pink October is breast cancer awareness month. This year we had a chat with the Executive Director of the largest European breast cancer patient advocacy organisation. Find out what she said and learn more about what the EU is doing to support breast cancer prevention and care.
